subject: NovusAI SOC 2 re-attestation: evidence matrix, retention, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice@novusai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements <procurements@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00Z
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention ask (NovusAI renewal)

Kimberly,

As NovusAI starts our renewal for Q1, our security team needs to confirm Redwood's SOC 2 re-attestation plan and provide a tidy evidence matrix for the auditor. Two critical asks from our side:

1) Retention: auditors expect a 24-month window for API request/response audit logs. Can Redwood commit to a 24-month retention window for the production logging stream used by our account (NVA-prod)? If this requires a change in plan/term please outline options and costs.

2) Evidence matrix: we need a spreadsheet detailing where artifacts live, point contacts, expected delivery dates, and any manual steps (e.g., log extracts, WORM storage snapshots). Please attach a template if you have one.

Additionally, our procurement lead has asked whether increased audit volume will require Reserved/Dedicated capacity (we may need a short burst during the audit window). If yes, please include a rough MAU/throughput estimate for a 3-month burst and pricing options (one-time or included credit).

Timeline: auditor kickoff tentatively scheduled 2027-01-10; we would like the matrix and retention plan by 2026-11-12 to start internal review.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice Moreno
Head of Security, NovusAI
alice@novusai.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: procurement_timeline.docx (timeline from NovusAI)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice@novusai.com>
Cc: Procurements <procurements@novusai.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation + retention ask (NovusAI renewal)

Alice — thanks for the clear asks. We can support the audit and I've outlined a pragmatic plan below. Attaching an evidence matrix template (evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx) and a short log retention summary (log_retention_summary.pdf).

Quick answers up front:
- Retention: We can extended production API request/response logs to 24 months, but that requires a term amendment for archival storage costs; Ive included pricing scenarios in the MAU estimate attachment.
- Capacity: For the dedicated audit window we can provision a short 3-month burst of Reserved capacity. Typical uplift sizing for similar customers is ~20-35% sustained throughput depending on sampling. See MAU estimate (mau_estimate_Q4.csv).

Proposed next steps (timeline):
- By 2026-11-09: Redwood returns completed evidence matrix template with artifact locations and point contacts. (Owner: Kimberly)
- By 2026-11-12: Novus internal review.
- By 2026-12-01: Sign term amendment (if required) to cover retention and burst capacity.
- 2027-01-01 — 2027-03-31: Optional 3-month reserved capacity burst aligned with audit.

Commercial note: As a renewal concession we can apply a one-time credit equivalent to one month of Reserved capacity against the first month of the burst if Novus signs a 24-month renewal (we'd need a simple amendment). I flagged this with Sales Ops and referenced deal id NVA-2026-RNW.

Ive cc'd internal team members who will own artifacts and cost estimates. Will follow up with an internal plan and a filled matrix shortly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx; log_retention_summary.pdf; mau_estimate_Q4.csv
